subject: Future Tech
title: RNA Editing
description: Learn RNA Editing in one minute.

hook.text: RNA carries the message from DNA to the protein factory.

buildup.text: CRISPR-Cas13 targets RNA instead of DNA. It can degrade or edit specific RNA molecules inside living cells.

discovery.text: RNA edits are temporary by nature. RNA molecules degrade in hours, so any change is automatically short-lived.

twist.text: That's an advantage. For conditions needing temporary fixes, like inflammation or acute pain, RNA editing is ideal.

climax.text: Researchers have used RNA editing to correct genetic mutations in human cells without making permanent DNA changes.

punchline.text: Editing the message is safer than editing the blueprint.

quiz.question: Why are RNA edits inherently temporary?
